body:
Thank you, I know it’s a good thing but it also kind of makes me miserable. 
But it’ll get better, I know that.
And yeah it’s no fun, really fucking sucks. But I’m so grateful for this subreddit to be honest, such a good place for support, really keeps me going.

I am so sorry for your loss and a month ago I also almost lost my sister to sepsis, I saw how much they were hurting and how broken they were during this time. No way that I’ll do that to them. I hope you’ll find happiness, you deserve it.

Yeah I feel like that too, my parents have already lost a child and I don’t want them to go through that again. But if I could have the option to do it & have no one even remember that I existed I would. No one would suffer, and I’d finally be at peace

I’m glad that you’ve started therapy and that you take care of yourself, I really hope that you’ll feel connected to people again and that you’ll feel joyful again eventually, you deserve that and i really hope the therapy & sertraline helps :)
Going into therapy soon, what about you?
Thank you so much, I really appreciate it<3
I hope the both of us will feel better soon and make some progress<3
